UC Berkeley / vLLM Team's listed product is vLLM, categorized under open source & self-hosted models, with high-throughput inference engine as the function this data names first.

The data also tags vLLM with open-source and no external data sharing, description of what the product does rather than how well it does it. It also notes self-hosted, one of the few entries in this set where the product touches compute or physical infrastructure directly rather than sitting purely at the application layer.

Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to github.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about UC Berkeley / vLLM Team's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
UC Berkeley / vLLM Team is listed as a university lab and a non-profit organization. Its recorded website is github.com. The text harvested from that address describes GitHub itself, which the site calls the world's most widely adopted AI-powered developer platform, where developers, businesses, and an open source community build software, and which offers AI and automation tools for building and shipping software. That text does not describe the vLLM team or its work.

The one product held for the organization is vLLM, described as a high-throughput inference engine that is open source and self-hosted, with no external data sharing. Its listed address is github.com/vllm-project/vllm.

No litigation, no MCP servers, and no other products are recorded for this organization.
